comment: Brian VO Ep33 (300s): Scotland vs Morocco, Group C, real kickoff ~Sat 20 Jun 2026 01:00. VERIFIED HOOK (web-sourced, cite in README): SCOTLAND 1974 — went to the World Cup in West Germany and came home the ONLY unbeaten team, yet were eliminated in the group on goal difference (beat Zaire 2-0, drew Brazil 0-0, drew Yugoslavia 1-1); the FIRST nation ever knocked out of a World Cup finals without losing a match (Celtic FC, SPFL). MOROCCO 2022 — the FIRST African team ever to reach a World Cup semifinal, finished fourth, the best finish by any African or Arab nation; Hakimi's panenka beat Spain on penalties in the round of 16 (Olympics.com, ESPN). THEME: two nations bound by glorious near-misses — perfection that wasn't enough, and a dream that came up one step short. lines.text: In nineteen seventy-four, a team went to the World Cup... and never lost a single game. And still, they were sent home.
Perfection — punished by arithmetic. The cruellest exit in football history. And tonight, that ghost is in the stands again.
Last time, we predicted the United States would edge Australia two-one. Tonight: the unbeaten heartbreak of Scotland... against the kings of the near-miss.
Welcome back to WorldCup twenty-six Legends, episode thirty-three. Scotland... versus Morocco. The Tartan Army... against the Atlas Lions.
And stay with me — because both of these nations have touched greatness, and felt it slip through their fingers.
First, the history. And it is true. West Germany, nineteen seventy-four. Scotland faced the world... and refused to lose.
They drew with mighty Brazil. They beat Zaire. They did not lose one match.
And they went home anyway — the first team ever eliminated from a World Cup without a single defeat. Out by one goal.
Now cross the water, to Morocco. Twenty twenty-two. A night that stopped a continent.
They knocked out Spain on penalties. They beat Portugal. The first African nation ever to reach a World Cup semifinal.
Fourth in the world — the greatest run African football has ever seen. So close to immortality they could taste it.
Two proud nations who learned the same hard lesson: that the line between legend and heartbreak is thinner than a blade of grass.
Now, Scotland. Scott McTominay — Serie A's best, the midfielder nobody believed in, who scores from nowhere.
Andy Robertson, the captain. Kieran Tierney, the warrior. John McGinn, twenty goals from midfield. Lawrence Shankland up top.
And across from them — Morocco. Disciplined, fearless, world-class.
Achraf Hakimi flies down the right. Hakim Ziyech bends magic with his left foot.
Youssef En-Nesyri climbs above everyone. Sofyan Amrabat runs forever. And young Bilal El-Khannouss pulls the strings.
So here is the duel. Highland fire and a refusal to break... against the desert wind that swept aside the giants of Europe.
And stay with me — because how this one ends... almost nobody will see coming.
Our prediction — built on two stubborn defences, and on two goalkeepers who decided this would be their night. Watch.
The thirty-third minute. Robertson swings the corner, and McTominay rises — a header flying for the corner.
But the Moroccan keeper throws himself across and palms it over. An impossible save. Still nil-nil.
Then Morocco strike back. Ziyech whips it in, and En-Nesyri towers above the defence — a header arrowing in.
And the Scottish keeper flies through the air... and somehow keeps it out. The crowd cannot believe it.
Nil-nil at the whistle, in our story. No goals — and yet, two saves nobody will ever forget.
Do you agree? Comment SCOTLAND if the Tartan Army hold firm. Comment MOROCCO if the Atlas Lions find a way through.
And that ghost in the stands? Legend number thirty-three: the Ghost of Goal Difference. He has haunted every team that did everything right... and still went home.
Tonight he came to see if heartbreak finally turns to glory. Collect him inside the game.
Which brings us to YOU. At WorldCup twenty-six dot world, pick three of the forty-eight nations — and every goal they score, scores for you.
Free to play, just for fun. Climb the leaderboard. No prizes. Hit like, send this to a friend, and subscribe — the legends are only beginning.
